parameters.jsCode:
// Purpose: Prepare Outbox Intent. Keep this deterministic and fail closed.
const m = $('Build Canonical Delta Artifact').first().json.manifest, source = $('Verify Archive and Execution Context').first().json, a = $json;
const imported_ids = m.transactions.map(t => t.imported_id);
const idempotency_key = `statement:${source.document_sha256}`;
return [{ json: {
            schema_version: 1,
            outbox_id: idempotency_key,
            batch_id: idempotency_key,
            run_id: source.run_id,
            idempotency_key,
            actual_file_id: source.actual_file_id,
            delta_sha256: a.artifact_sha256,
            delta_artifact_item_id: a.delta_artifact_item_id,
            delta_artifact_etag: a.delta_artifact_etag,
            delta_schema_version: a.delta_schema_version,
            config_version: source.config_version,
            parser_version: m.parser_version,
            state: 'PREPARED',
            account_id: source.account_id,
            card_code: source.card_code,
            historical_import: m.historical_import === true,
            ...(m.historical_import === true
                ? { historical_source: m.historical_source, historical_account_id: m.historical_account_id }
                : {}),
            imported_ids,
            start_date: m.period_start,
            end_date: m.period_end,
        } }];
